packageRules.description: Group non-breaking updates into a single weekly PR.
TypeScript 7 breaks vue-tsc. vue-tsc's peer range is an unenforcing '>=5.0.0', so the ceiling has to be pinned here.
The docs site is pinned to @nuxt-themes/docus 1.x, which is abandoned and requires Nuxt 3 and @nuxt/content 2.x. Do not let Renovate push it to Nuxt 4.
